rosterSource.authorityStatement: This file is the authoritative client-certification roster for honua-server. The Claude artifact named above is the historical source that seeded it and is explicitly non-authoritative: it must not be cited as the roster, and any divergence resolves in favour of this file together with docs/gis/data/client-certification-matrix.v1.json.
rosterSource.countBasis: Distinct client identities. declaredEntryCount is the artifact's own headline tally (11 certified live + 4 built-unrun + 22 proposed + 4 out of scope). reconciledEntryCount is the number of entries in this file. Every difference is itemised in reconciliationNotes, and the note deltas must sum to reconciledEntryCount minus declaredEntryCount.

reconciliationNotes.note: The artifact's Excluded section has four bullets, but the third bullet, 'Golden Surfer, Avenza Maps', names two distinct clients. Splitting it raises the artifact's 41 headline entries to 42 distinct client identities.

The headline tally claims 4 'Built, unrun' and 22 'Proposed'. The tier tables mark only 2 rows 'Built, unrun' (desktop-arcgis, esri-dotnet) and enumerate 24 unbuilt rows (16 Tier 1 'Proposed' plus 8 Tier 2 'On demand'). The two differences offset exactly, so the 41 total is unchanged. The per-row tier tables are authoritative; the artifact gives no basis for identifying which two additional rows the headline counted as built.

The headline '11 certified live' equals the 9 rows the tier tables label Live, Live nightly, or 1117/1117, plus the 2 rows labelled 'Partial'. This roster does not treat 'Partial' as activated at the source artifact's revision: esri-js-maps-sdk was active but awaiting-federation, and py-pystac was planned and awaiting-evidence. esri-js-maps-sdk still declares requiredTier `none`; py-pystac was promoted to `active` with requiredTier `nightly` in #3392, which committed its envelope. The 41 total is unchanged.

client-certification-matrix.v1.json registers an active `arcgis-stub` lane with committed evidence for featureserver, mapserver, and portal. The artifact has no row for it because it folded the stub into the ArcGIS Pro harness column. It is a distinct identity here because it is a stub harness, not a shipped client, and must never be read as certifying ArcGIS Pro.

CROSS_CLIENT_CERTIFICATION_MATRIX.md registers an Esri Leaflet browser sub-lane with its own EL-EXT-01..04 extension IDs, and tests/js-browser/esri-leaflet implements it, but the artifact has no row for it. Including it makes the gap visible: no lanes-array row declares EL-EXT-* applicability and no envelope is committed under tests/baselines/client-compat.

denominatorRules.invariant: Every row that is not both active and activated declares requiredTier 'none' and is therefore structurally incapable of passing or blocking any gate. `intendedTierOnActivation` records the tier such a row would take once activated; it is planning metadata and is never read by a gate.

capabilityApplicabilityBinding.statement: #3387 remains the single capability-applicability authority. This roster classifies client identities only: which clients exist, their status, activation state, tier, runtime, licensing, and evidence producer. It deliberately declares no capability-level denominator. #3387 joins to this file by `id` whenever a capability decision names a canonical external client, so client identity has exactly one home and the capability denominator has exactly one home.
mustNotDo: Derive a capability coverage percentage from this file.
Treat operationApplicability as a capability-level applicability decision. It is the CERT-* client-operation vocabulary from CROSS_CLIENT_CERTIFICATION_MATRIX.md, not the capability matrix.

projection.statement: honua-release and honua-evidence consume this file. They do not maintain a second copy of the roster and they do not read the historical artifact.

consumers.purpose: Client half of the release denominator.
consumers.gapCellRule: A row required by the frozen 2026.1 profile (honua-release#158) that is not both active and activated must render as a blocking gap cell, never as an omission.

consumers.denominatorRule: Accept a client receipt only when its client_lane joins a row whose status == 'active'; verify the producer against evidenceProducer and the client pin against clientVersionPolicy.
mustNotCount: A receipt whose client_lane resolves to a planned or excluded row.
A receipt from a producer other than the row's declared evidenceProducer.
A receipt for a fixtureProjection.kind of 'governed-exception' relabelled as canonical-fixture.
